items: Encrypted data, in transit and at rest

items.question: Do I need my own list of leads to get started?
items.answer: No. Use Lead Management to discover companies by country, industry, and keywords, then import the ones you want to work.

items.question: Can I bring my own email provider?
items.answer: Yes. Campaigns are designed to work with a transactional email provider you connect from Settings once you're ready to send.

items.question: Is there a free plan?
items.answer: Yes, the Free plan includes limited lead searches and one active campaign so you can try the full workflow before upgrading.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Subscriptions are month-to-month and can be canceled from Settings → Subscription at any time.

items.question: Does Nexora integrate with our existing tools?
items.answer: Yes. Nexora connects with your transactional email provider and works alongside the tools your team already uses, so you can adopt it without ripping out your existing stack.

items.question: How is our data protected?
items.answer: Every workspace uses encrypted data in transit and at rest, with role-based access control so team members only see what they need to.
